section_summary: This section concludes an assessment of Japan’s wartime economy, arguing that its industrial strength was concentrated in Japan and nearby continental territories. It examines production, transport, and raw material stockpiles, then presents an administrative chart and statistical charts and tables for 1943.

subfiles.title: Assessment of Japan’s economic potential and the Inner Zone
subfiles.about: Japan’s industrial capacity, strategic geography, and ability to sustain war production from its northern economic core.
subfiles.summary: The report considers continental air bases and rail links, estimates 1943 production growth, and compares Japan’s output with other belligerents. It argues that Japan, Korea, Manchuria, North China, and Formosa formed a relatively self-sufficient industrial core. It assesses steel, coal, food, transport, oil, and other raw materials, concluding that stockpiling could support a prolonged defense of that core.

subfiles.title: Administrative Organization of Japan’s War-Time Economy
subfiles.about: The ministries, planning bodies, companies, and control associations involved in Japan’s wartime economy.
subfiles.summary: Charts central authorities, ministries, development companies, and industry control bodies.

subfiles.title: Production of Ferrous Raw Materials, Iron and Steel in Japan and Occupied Areas
subfiles.about: Regional iron ore, coking coal, pig iron, and steel production and flows.
subfiles.summary: Maps production and shipments of ferrous materials across Japan and occupied areas.

subfiles.title: Japanese Requirements for, and Production of Metals Available to the Japanese, by Producing Regions, 1943
subfiles.about: Estimated Japanese metal requirements, stocks, and production by region in 1943.
subfiles.summary: Compares metal requirements and projected stocks with production available from Japan, occupied territories, and other sources.

subfiles.title: Japanese Requirements for, and Production of Non-Metallic Minerals and Miscellaneous Products Available to the Japanese, by Producing Regions, 1943
subfiles.about: Estimated requirements, stocks, and regional production of non-metallic minerals and other products.
subfiles.summary: Tabulates supplies including coal, oil, salt, rubber, and phosphate rock.
